## What and why

<!-- What was wrong or missing, what you changed, how you checked it. One change per pull request. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format`, `npm run check` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] Code, tests, screenshots and this description contain **no real store data or credentials**.
- [ ] A new file under `public/` is listed in `server/http/public-files.mjs`. A new setting is in `.env.example` and `docs/self-hosting.md`.
- [ ] Nothing stored or registered outside the repository was renamed (`docs/architecture.md`, "Names that never change").
- [ ] Code a TV loads avoids the newer built-ins (`docs/architecture.md`, "TV code stays in the field").
- [ ] The docs that describe this change are updated.
- [ ] A visual change comes with before and after screenshots at desktop and phone width, taken from the sample board.
